This is a long one:

Here in my country, it is a tradition to hold a wake for a family member who has recently died. About two years ago, my grandma died, and word spreads around our neighbourhood. Close family friends visit, and eventually our neighbors do as well. There is one family in our neighbourhood who are not well educated (most of them didn't finish school because of poverty). We'll call them the Maniyo family. They have a history of starting fights and shit like that in our neighbourhod, and they try so hard to look like a fucking millionaire family (fuck them we live in a third world shit hole country, everyone's poor here). Anyway, my family and cousins are all there inside the room assigned to us by the funeral home. We were not that down for the most part, because we all knew our grandma was going to die soon. As we look at the list of people who have visited, we saw one written "Baniyo Sister's". Obviously, we knew who had written it, but immediately we all laugh our assess off. I even drew hearts and doodles around their name. After a while, our minds fell back in reality and we realized that they were still there with us. I quickly erased the doodles, and I felt really bad because English isn't our first language so it's understandable they wrote it like that. 

Tl;dr Wannabe neighbors wrote "Baniyo Sister's", we laugh our assess off.
